description: Source code for the TeleReporterEmitter class, which implements the ReporterV2 interface for reporting test events in Playwright, including serialization of test results, steps, attachments, and communication via message sink.

classes.name: TeleReporterEmitter
classes.description: Implements a test reporter that emits test events and results for Playwright, serializing data and communicating via a message sink.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string 'v2'.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Serializes and sends the configuration data.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Serializes and reports the beginning of test suites.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a test and sends a message with test ID and initial result.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Pauses test execution, records error count, and sends pause event.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Serializes and reports test end, including errors and attachments.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a test step and sends a message.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a test step and serializes step data.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Reports a test error.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles stdout output during tests.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles stderr output during tests.

methods.name: _onStdIO
methods.description: Internal method to process stdio chunks.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Reports the end of the test run with final results.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the reporter prints to stdio (returns false).

methods.name: _serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes configuration data for reporting.

methods.name: _serializeProject
methods.description: Serializes project data including suites and tests.

methods.name: _serializeProjectUseOptions
methods.description: Serializes project-specific 'use' options.

methods.name: _serializeSuite
methods.description: Serializes a test suite and its entries.

methods.name: _serializeTest
methods.description: Serializes individual test case data.

methods.name: _serializeResultStart
methods.description: Serializes the start state of a test result.

methods.name: _serializeResultEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end state of a test result, including errors.

methods.name: _sendNewAttachments
methods.description: Sends new attachments associated with a test result.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes attachments, converting bodies to base64 if needed.

methods.name: _serializeStepStart
methods.description: Serializes the start of a test step.

methods.name: _serializeStepEnd
methods.description: Serializes the end of a test step.

methods.name: _relativeAnnotationLocations
methods.description: Converts annotation locations to relative paths.

methods.name: _relativeLocation
methods.description: Converts absolute location paths to relative paths.

methods.name: _relativePath
methods.description: Converts absolute file paths to relative paths based on rootDir.
